invariants.rationale: The method always returns a List<V>, so result is not null.
After grouping and reducing by key, result may contain fewer elements than the input data.
parallelism typically specifies the level of parallelism and should be positive.
data is an input list and is assumed to be non-null for the method to execute.
Each element of result should be non-null, as they are produced by a non-null reduction.
